viewing_check: Read the deck's model plate (TC-121 vs TC-131SD) and the Garrard model on the deck plate under the platter or near the arm; check the cartridge has a stylus; read the speaker labels on the back (SS-xx); power on if allowed (amp lamp, deck transport, turntable spins at 33/45).
